J'zargo publishes short manga concepts on pixiv, pixivFANBOX, and X. Two of them are officially translated.
HANZO, The Beheader Manga Version: https://jzargosexperime.fanbox.cc/posts/12170380 / https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/146767287 (partial on pixiv, full on pixivFANBOX)
Yamada and Natsuki.: https://jzargosexperime.fanbox.cc/posts/12245290 / https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/147161654

Since most of them are not translated, I wanted to try my hand at it. I have currently translated the first three and will update this gallery with more as I finish them. This is my first time translating, so there may be some mistakes.

page 1: Konna Manga Kakitai-an: Taima Kenshi Nekomine Mike / Manga I Want to Draw: Anti-demon Warrior Nekomine Mike (https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/140050225)
pages 2-3: Kakitai Manga-an: Shizue-san After Shota Ichinichi Azukari Hen / Manga I Want to Draw: Shizue-san After - Taking Care of Shota for a Day (https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/137990959)
page 4: Kakitai Manga-an: Tokumei Ninja Hanzo Manga Version / Manga I Want to Draw: Special Ops Ninja Hanzo Manga Version (https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/135718266)
